invariants.text: Customer.customer_id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
Purchase.purchase_id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
Purchase.customer_id must reference an existing Customer.customer_id
The total amount spent by a customer is the sum of the amounts from all their purchases.
A purchase is associated with exactly one customer through the customer_id field.
The purchase_date of a purchase must be on or after the date of the first purchase made by the same customer.
A customer's purchase history includes all purchases linked to their customer_id.
The amount field in a purchase must be greater than zero.
